name: output-channel-contract
description: Three output channels per tool: content[0].text = TOON-encoded (LLM-visible data), details = plain struct (agent metadata + renderResult inputs), renderResult = TUI card reading from details. Never TOON-encode details — breaks renderResult. TOON only for content[0].text.

name: tool-registration
description: Each tool: registerTool with pi metadata, TypeBox schema, execute handler, structured details, visible content.text, optional renderResult. Source, compiled output, and tests agree on parameter names. camelCase for pi schema exposure. Structured details = source of truth for agents.

name: streaming
description: find/grep/shell stream via throttled onUpdate (500ms makeThrottle). onUpdate carries content:[] — LLM sees no partial TOON. TOON encoded once at finalization. renderResult gets isPartial:true while streaming. Kill handle from runner for limit abort. ast_search not streaming (ast-grep emits JSON array not JSONL).

name: universal-ops-schema
description: Every tool uses {ops: Op[]} where Op is discriminated by op field (TypeBox Literal). Single op = one-element array. Mixed op types per call. New capability = new op variant added to union; tool interface never changes. Execute dispatches on op. TOON merges results across all ops. Replaces edits[], files[], commands[], action fields.

name: linehash-cli-boundary
description: Heavy file-op logic belongs in linehash CLI not Pi extension TypeScript. Extension is thin adapter: registerTool, TypeBox schema, hook registration, encodeToon, renderResult, details shaping, display helpers, streaming+throttle, truncation. linehash owns: fuzzy matching, snapshot, diff, anchored diff, symbol edit, patch-apply.

name: nu-foundation
description: All backend tool execution runs through Nu foundation layer in Flox env. Flox pins: nu, rg, fd, eza, bat, delta, ast-grep, linehash, sd. Activated at pi-dev.ts launcher. Nu wrappers in nu/lib/ (grep/find/ls/read/diff/query/bat/sd). TypeScript extension → thin adapter only. JSON parsing moves to Nu.

name: defense-in-depth
description: Four layers: 0=AgentFS(FUSE/SQLite COW)+YoloFS(staging/snapshots) filesystem boundary; 1=profile tool whitelist (registerTool only for allowed); 2=profile op whitelist (TypeBox schema union restricted); 3=own dcg(.toml pattern packs)+Reinforced Agent reviewer(light.sock)+slb peer approval. Outer layer cannot be bypassed by compromised inner.

name: navigation-stack
description: repo_map → outline(ctags+linehash anchors,{name,kind,line,anchor,signature}) → read(path,offset=N,limit=50) → grep/ast_search → edit with anchor. Replaces ls-all/find-all/read-whole-file. Outline anchor enables direct edit targeting without re-read. linehash anchor = hash of content at line for drift detection.

title: Vendored compiled pi binary
rationale: Compile @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent with bun build --compile; apply patch-pi before compilation so patches are baked in. No node_modules at runtime. Extensions bundle all deps inline (pi-tui, typebox, toon, diff; no --external flags). pi-coding-agent moved to devDependencies. data.tar.gz contains no node_modules.

title: Extension bundling strategy
rationale: bun build each extension to index.js with no --external flags. pi-tui bundled inline (safe: compiled pi has its own separate copy, duck-typed rendering; Nix pi proved separate instances work). pi-coding-agent is type-only in extensions so tree-shaken away. Installed data dir is self-contained: no bun, no npm required at runtime.

name: harness-intervention
description: harnessIntervention(ctx, msg) → ctx.ui.notify('harness intervention: ' + msg, 'info'). Uniform user-visible line for all scaffolding overrides (write-guard, read-guard, output-parser, quality-monitor, turn-cap). Single consistent surface for all hook-layer interventions.

name: file-checkpoint
description: tool_call hook: if edit/write and target exists → captureFile(path) writes <ts>.content+<ts>.meta to ~/.pi/checkpoints/<sha256-16>/; prunes to newest 10. tool_result hook: replaces details.diff with raw diff -u output → delta renders clean diff. revert_file{path,checkpoint_id?} is the only tool card. captureFile+diffAgainstCheckpoint exported for invoke.ts.

name: quality-stack-hooks
description: output-parser (turn_end): detect fenced/tagged/bare-JSON tool calls in assistant text; repairJson 6-pass; pi.sendUserMessage deliverAs:followUp nudge. write-guard (tool_call): path normalization; blocks write to existing file -> redirects to edit. read-guard (tool_result): ctx.getContextUsage() overflow trim to 30 lines. quality-monitor (turn_end): 4+2 checks — empty/hallucinated-tool/stuck-loop/malformed + read-loop (N reads without write) + patch-spiral (N consecutive patch failures same file). All use harnessIntervention(ctx,msg). State resets per before_agent_start.

name: skill-inject-knowledge-inject
description: skill-inject (before_agent_start): loads skills/tools/*.md (frontmatter: target_tool, token_cost); 3-priority: (1) last failed tool error-recovery, (2) last 2 tool calls recency, (3) keyword INTENT_MAP on user prompt; budget 300 tok; research-trigger regex injects Research-first directive. knowledge-inject (before_agent_start): loads skills/knowledge+protocols/*.md; keyword-scores vs prompt (threshold 2.0, cap 150 tok/entry); publishes requires_tools -> skill-inject picks up. Both read bundled skills/ copy, not ~/.llm. Scratchpad always-injects full content as [ACTIVE_CLIPBOARD]. Orientation Block on cold-start (idle >1h).

name: split-brain-model-router
description: extra-tools/model: automatic split-brain router via light.sock (Gemma 4 E2B ONNX q4f16, @huggingface/transformers + Bun, CPU-first, WebGPU optional via INFERENCE_LOCAL_GPU_ENABLED=1). Classifies message before Pi calls lemonade -> {escalate, model, effort}. model_switch tool for explicit override; no-arg = escalate to profile.escalation {model,effort}. Pi provider re-registration: pi.unregisterProvider+pi.registerProvider with new defaultModel. Always writes (model,effort) to profiles.json for overseer drift-check. Remote lemonade host: 100.108.123.126:13305. Chat->light, inbox/task->pro.

title: Pi handles format translation; little-coder extension handles token budget injection
rationale: Clean separation avoids Pi source changes. Pi translates thinking level to provider format (qwen-chat-template, reasoning_effort, etc). Extension injects thinking_budget_tokens:N via before_model_request. models.json compat.thinkingBudgets {minimal,low,medium,high} per model. Lemonade must start without --reasoning-budget (default -1). Per-profile defaults: coordinator=high, coder=medium, reviewer=low, watchdog=off.

title: Basic-tools phases 1–22 complete and verified
rationale: All 8 tools (read/edit/write/grep/find/ls/shell/ast_search) implemented with TOON output, streaming, renderResult, truncation metadata. File-checkpoint extension added (tool_call+tool_result hooks; revert_file tool; ~/.pi/checkpoints/). Output channel contract established: content[0].text=TOON, details=plain struct. tsconfig excludes test files; bunx tsc --noEmit exits 0; 64 tests pass. Two-binary vendored-pi distribution verified working in dev mode 2026-06-02.
